lp.ackIntro: Please read and acknowledge the following statements carefully before submitting your application.
lp.ack1: I acknowledge that the liquidity provider operates as an independent third party and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or representing Capimax RT or any SPV.
lp.ack2: I understand that as a liquidity provider, I am not obligated to guarantee exits, buy all requests, maintain fixed pricing, or provide permanent liquidity.
lp.ack3: I agree to comply with all platform terms, conditions, and applicable regulations, and to undergo the KYB (Know Your Business) verification process.

lpPage.metaDescription: Join the Capimax RT Liquidity Provider program. Provide optional liquidity for owners, set your own terms, and profit from price differences.
lpPage.heroDesc: The Liquidity Provider program allows qualified third parties to provide optional and organized liquidity for owners wishing to exit their tokenized real estate ownership, according to terms, pricing, and limits set by the liquidity provider itself.
lpPage.noticeDesc: The liquidity provider is not a redemption entity, does not guarantee exit, and does not represent an obligation on the platform or SPV. All exit operations are subject to the liquidity provider's terms and compliance approvals.
lpPage.howDesc: A simple, transparent process to become a liquidity provider on our platform.
